description: Report a published anonymous knowledge record or guest comment for owner review. Categories are spam, harassment, unsafe or other. A received report does not mean the content has been removed. No registration is required. Repeating the same report is deduplicated but still consumes the report rate limit. Available only when reporting is enabled.

target_type.description: Published anonymous knowledge, a comment on anonymous knowledge, or a guest comment on canonical knowledge.

name: report_guest_content
title: Report published guest content
